name: Cruise ship
headline: length
subtitle: Example: Legend of the Seas (Icon class, 2026)
description: Legend of the Seas, the third Icon-class ship built by Meyer Turku in Finland for Royal Caribbean, is one of the largest cruise ships ever built. The shipyard lists it as 365 m long, with a gross tonnage of 250,800 and room for 5,610 passengers. Gross tonnage measures a ship's enclosed volume, not its weight.

measures.label: Length
measures.note: Overall length as listed by the builder

facts.text: Meyer Turku lists Legend of the Seas at 250,800 gross tonnage and 5,610 passengers.

caveats: Cruise ships vary widely in size. This page uses one of the largest as an example.
The drawing is scaled to the 365 m length; its height is illustrative.
